review:
A 25-line horror game where townsfolk pay you in coins for hunting monsters. Six or more coins trigger Horror Respin, a hold-and-win round.

Fill one row with coins for the Mini (20x), and more rows for the Mega (100x) and Grand (1,000x). Free spins come round often – about once every 98 spins – so sessions are lively, if not explosive. Medium-low volatility, a 1,299x cap and 94.65% RTP.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 98 spins on average)
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
